status: Proposal only; root owns live catalog/binding integration, Claude owns engine changes. No UV changes proposed.

sampling.preserve: NativeSamples.road uses worldPosition.xz / sampling.asphalt.scale and blends two region-offset samples with unshifted gradients. Keep scale [2,2] and existing source UVs.
sampling.important: The material field is world-xz even where source geometry publishes U-across/V-station. Do not rewire highway lane/gutter UVs for this asset batch.
sampling.uniqueMarks: Current region-offset crossfade can duplicate/soften a repair or crack. These are condition-field candidates; exact sparse road repairs/multi-panel cracks need placement-aware content, not an assumption that a catalog variant alone makes them unique.

defaultCleanWornPair.effectLimit: Current effect blends clean/worn colour and normal with wear, but roughness and AO come only from the main/worn slots. A clean visual at wear=0 can still receive stained roughness. A fully coherent blend needs cleanRoughness/cleanAo support or an equivalent selected complete map set; send engine changes to Claude.

fourConditionSelection.rule: Select a complete coordinated condition set, not only basecolor. Root chooses the opt-in binding/set name. No name or selector was installed by this task.
fourConditionSelection.fixtureControl: For an isolated condition fixture, set both cleanBasecolor/basecolor and cleanNormal/normal to that same chosen condition so wear interpolation cannot erase it; roughness and AO from the condition. This is a review control, not a default live binding recommendation.
fourConditionSelection.productionConditionMeaning: Crack and repair visibility must follow the selected condition/placement, not disappear arbitrarily because a global clean/worn colour blend happens to be low.

parking.asphaltBranch: Feed the same asphalt clean/worn or complete condition maps into basecolor, normal, roughness, ao, cleanBasecolor and cleanNormal. Keep the existing entrance mix/panel geometry intact.
effectLimits: Parking colour blends clean/worn road colour before entrance mix.
Parking normal uses main road normal, not a cleanNormal wear blend.
Parking AO is parkingAo across the effect; road AO is currently not consumed for the asphalt portion.
The unused parking surface in some worlds still requires an explicit fixture or actual placement check.

directPhotographedSurfaces.asphalt-clean: Candidate asphalt-clean-1 full set; keep world-xz [2,2].
directPhotographedSurfaces.asphalt-patched: Candidate asphalt-patched-1 full set for already-authorized repair routes; do not create new placement/road strips solely from the material ID.
